info_entries.title: Tab/Tenon Length Calculation for Tubes
description: DIMENSION FORMAT: 'AxB tenons' → tab_length=A, tab_width=B (e.g. '40x3' → tab_length=40, tab_width=3).
LENGTH CALCULATION: tube_length = total_length - (2 * tab_width). NEVER use total_length directly as tube length.
EXAMPLES: '1106mm with 40x3 tenons' → tube_length=1106-(2*3)=1100. '500mm with 20x2 tabs' → tube_length=500-(2*2)=496.

PYTHON EXAMPLE: # '40x3 tenons, total 1106mm' → tab_length=40; tab_width=3; tube_length=1106-(2*3)  # =1100; tube=Part.makeSquareTube(tube_length,...); result=create_rectangular_tab(tube, tab_length, tab_width, tube_length, ...)
info_entries.rule: When user mentions total length with tabs/tenons, always subtract 2*tab_width to get actual tube_length.

info_entries.title: CRITICAL RULES for cutting tube
description: SQUARE/RECTANGULAR TUBE CUT: MUST use create_square_tube_angled_cuts(tube_shape, length, outer_width, outer_height, left_cut_angle, right_cut_angle). Cut direction is along Z-axis.

RECTANGULAR TUBE CRITICAL: When user specifies cut on a specific side (e.g. 'cut at 80° on the 60mm side'), that dimension MUST be outer_height in Part.makeRectangularTube(), because cut defaults to Z direction.
EXAMPLE: 'Tube cut at 80° on 60mm side' → Part.makeRectangularTube(length, outer_width, 60, thickness, ...) where 60 is outer_height.
CIRCULAR TUBE CUT: MUST use create_circular_tube_angled_cuts(tube_shape, length, outer_diameter, cut_angle_1_deg, cut_angle_2_deg).
info_entries.rule: Use create_square_tube_angled_cuts for square/rectangular tubes, create_circular_tube_angled_cuts for circular tubes. Cut direction is always along Z-axis.

info_entries.title: CRITICAL RULES for tube cut angle orientation
description: SHAPE AFTER CUT: TOP FACE (Z-max) = shorter face. BOTTOM FACE (Z-min) = longer face.
CUT DEPTH: depth of cut solid MUST be thickness + 2.0 to ensure complete cut through face only.
HOLE POSITIONING: holes on longer/shorter side MUST drill along Z axis.

AMBIGUITY RULE (Square Tubes, width=height): 'Largest/Longest side/Grand côté' = Bottom Face (Z-min). 'Shortest side/Petit côté' = Top Face (Z-max). NEVER place on Y-axis faces unless explicitly named 'vertical face/left side/right side'.
info_entries.rule: After angled cut: Z-max=shorter face, Z-min=longer face. Holes on these faces drill along Z. Square tubes: largest=bottom, shortest=top.

info_entries.title: CRITICAL RULES for tab/tenon function call and constraints
description: MANDATORY: For ANY tube with extensions/tabs/tenons, MUST call create_rectangular_tab(tube_shape, tab_length, tab_width, length, outer_width, outer_height, thickness, add_start_tab=True, add_end_tab=True). NO OTHER METHOD ALLOWED.
LENGTH PARAM: Use calculated tube_length (not total_length) for the 'length' parameter. tube_length = total_length - (2 * tab_width).
EXAMPLES: 'total length 1106mm with 40x3 tenons' → tube_length=1106-(2*3)=1100. 'total length 500mm with 20x2 tabs' → tube_length=500-(2*2)=496.
CUT END CONSTRAINT: If an end is cut (angled/bevel/any cut), tabs/tenons CANNOT be added to that cut end. Set add_start_tab=False or add_end_tab=False accordingly.

PYTHON EXAMPLE: tube_length=total_length-(2*tab_width); tube=Part.makeSquareTube(tube_length,...); result=create_rectangular_tab(tube, tab_length, tab_width, tube_length, outer_width, outer_height, thickness, add_start_tab=False, add_end_tab=True)
info_entries.rule: Always use create_rectangular_tab() for tube tabs. Never add tabs to cut ends.
